Which core modeling functions produce output 1 when the input is zero?

```{mcq}
#| label: psp-1-32do
1. hillside() & flat() [hint: No, the output of hillside() is 1/2 when the input is zero]
2. flat() & exp2() [correct]
3. flat() & log2() [hint: log2() is heading off to minus infinity as the input gets close to zero.]
4. osc() & flat() [hint: Sorry. osc(0) is zero.]
```
:::
